strings.Авторское учебное изложение проверенных: Author's training summary of verified provisions, not a website facsimile
strings.В заданных условиях жалоба на решение МФ: Under the stated conditions, a complaint against the centre's decision goes to its founding authority; the scenario excludes a specially authorised official.
strings.В контрольном эпизоде жалоба удовлетворе: In the follow-up episode, the complaint was upheld. The centre reported cancelling the order, but this applicant's package has still not been forwarded.
strings.В приложении — распоряжение центра и его: The attachment contains the centre's order and official reply. The employee referred to that order.
strings.В учебном субъекте для рассмотрения жало: In the training region, no separate authorised official is designated to consider complaints against the service centre itself. Its founding authority accepts these complaints within its established jurisdiction.
strings.Всегда обжалуется только работник, котор: A complaint always concerns only the employee who accepted the documents.
strings.Выберите допустимые действия и проверьте: Choose permitted actions and check their order. Independent actions may be carried out in different sequences.
strings.Выдача результата услуги вместо компетен: Issuing the service result instead of the competent body exceeds your powers.
strings.Вымышленная учебная стажировка в подразд: A fictional training placement in a unit of the MFC public-service centre's founder. You prepare the review of a complaint against a decision of the centre itself. Under the case facts, the region's legal instrument has not designated another authorised official for these complaints. You do not decide whether to provide the service in place of the responsible authority.
strings.Вымышленный порядок организации предписы: The fictional organisation's procedure requires applications to be forwarded in batches on Fridays. This material establishes the complaint's subject; it is not a regulatory model for a real service centre.
strings.Да, есть расписка. Я не жалуюсь на отказ: Yes, I have a receipt. I am not complaining about refusal to accept it.
strings.Для решения о прекращении переписки учит: A decision to end correspondence takes account of repeated prior substantive replies, absence of new arguments or circumstances, and statutory conditions. Letter count alone is insufficient.
strings.Для уже опубликованной информации допуст: For information already published, a reply may identify the publication or the official website address where it appears. Verify that the requested information is actually on that official website. A direct link is more convenient, but is not itself the only format permitted by law.
strings.Если решение вопросов не относится к ком: If the issues lie outside the recipient's powers, the written appeal is forwarded to the competent body or official and the citizen is notified. An address does not establish authority.
strings.Есть документ центра, а не только расска: There is a centre document, not just an account of an individual employee.
strings.Жалоба на любой документ МФЦ относится т: A complaint against any service centre document concerns only the counter specialist.
strings.Жалоба на решение центра относится к учр: A complaint about the centre's decision goes to its founder when, as specified, no other authorised official exists.
strings.Жалоба подана учредителю. По учебным мат: The complaint was submitted to the founding authority. The training materials show that it challenges an organisational decision by the service centre itself affecting forwarding of already accepted documents. Refusal to accept documents and correction of a typo are not alleged. No special shortened period or other federal procedure is provided.
strings.Жалобу на решения и действия работника М: A complaint about a service centre employee's decisions and actions goes to that centre's director. Do not confuse a centre employee with the body providing the service.
strings.Жалобу на решения и действия самого МФЦ: A complaint about the service centre's own decisions and actions goes to its founding authority or an official authorised by a regulatory legal act of the constituent entity.
strings.Жалобу нельзя направить на рассмотрение: A complaint must not be referred for consideration to the body or official whose decision, action or inaction is challenged.
strings.Закрыть дело по сообщению об отмене расп: Close the case upon the report of the order's cancellation, without checking the package.
strings.Запрос информации о деятельности власти: A request for information on public-authority activities
strings.Запрос информации рассматривается по спе: An information request follows special rules. If the information does not concern the recipient's activities, apply referral to the competent body with notification to the user.
strings.Зафиксировать предмет жалобы и приложенн: Record the complaint's subject and attached documents
strings.Какое именно решение вы оспариваете?: Which specific decision are you challenging?
strings.Кому направляется жалоба в этих условиях: To whom is the complaint sent under these conditions?
strings.Любая задержка означает отказ принять до: Any delay means a refusal to accept documents.
strings.Любая подпись работника превращает решен: Any employee's signature turns a centre decision into a complaint solely about that employee.
strings.Мне объяснили, что мой пакет не отправля: They explained that my package was held under the centre's uniform procedure. The employee showed an order: all such applications are kept until Friday. I challenge this centre procedure, not the specialist's personal conduct.
strings.На рассмотрение уполномоченному подразде: For review by the authorised unit of the MFC's founder.
strings.Найдите норму и проверьте её применимост: Find the provision and check its applicability. A source page does not replace justification of the decision.
strings.Найдите норму, разграничивающую адресато: Find the provision distinguishing recipients of complaints against an employee and against the service centre itself.
strings.Начните с предмета обращения. Уточните,: Start with the appeal's subject. Clarify who made the disputed decision and which information is confirmed.
The organisation's decision is being challenged.
strings.Общий порядок самого центра: принятые па: The centre's general procedure: accepted packages are sent only on Fridays.
strings.Общий срок рассмотрения письменного обра: The general written-appeal consideration period is tied to registration. It is not a universal deadline for construction, repairs or pollution removal.
strings.Окончательно разрешить жалобу на сам цен: Resolve the complaint against the centre itself within the MFC being challenged.
strings.Орган обеспечивает объективное, всесторо: The body ensures objective, comprehensive and timely consideration, requests materials where needed and provides a substantive reply. An appeal does not replace a budget decision.
strings.Орган определяет подразделение или должн: The body designates the unit or officials responsible for information access. Publishing a law on a ministry website does not mean that ministry holds every requested local document.
strings.Организационное изменение и решение проб: An organisational change and resolution of an individual applicant's problem are distinct outcomes to verify.
strings.Оспаривается порядок, установленный сами: The disputed procedure was established by the service centre itself.
The dispute concerns a procedure established by the institution itself, not merely an employee's isolated action. This affects the complaint recipient.
strings.Отделите реквизиты документа от его прим: Separate a document's particulars from its application. In the working source check, attach a specific passage and extract information from it.
strings.Оценить только наличие подписи, не читая: Check only for a signature without reading the contents.
strings.Пакет принят. Центр в официальном ответе: The package was accepted. In an official reply, the centre confirmed that the delay followed its organisational decision, not an employee's unauthorised action.
strings.По условию оспаривается решение самого М: The scenario challenges the MFC's own decision; no specially authorised regional official has been appointed. Find the recipient and rule without replacing the complaint's subject with an individual employee's action.
strings.Подготовить материалы для рассмотрения у: Prepare materials for the founding authority's consideration
strings.Подготовить мотивированный ответ после п: Prepare a reasoned reply after the decision is made
strings.Подменить жалобу на организацию жалобой: Replace the complaint against the organisation with one solely against its employee
strings.Подпись не отменяет анализ субъекта реше: A signature does not remove the need to identify whose decision it is. The specific addressee depends on the complaint's subject and the region's legal instrument.
strings.Помощник: «В распоряжении есть подпись р: Assistant: “The instruction bears the director's signature. Therefore, the organisational decision automatically counts only as an ordinary employee's action.”
strings.Поручить окончательное решение специалис: Assign the final decision to the service-counter specialist.
strings.После принятия решения заявителю направл: After the decision, a reasoned reply must be sent to the applicant no later than the following day. This is a separate action, not a new full complaint consideration period.
strings.Потребовать заново подать все уже принят: Require resubmission of all previously accepted documents without grounds.
strings.Правило исчисления в этом учебном деле:: Calculation rule for this training case: the initial day is excluded. Count working days in Russia's five-day working week; no regional additions apply. The end of such a period already falls on a working day.
strings.Предмет не относится к пятидневному срок: This subject does not fall under the five-day period for refusal to accept documents.
strings.При нескольких вопросах, относящихся к р: Where several issues belong to different bodies, copies of the appeal are forwarded to the appropriate recipients. Keep the issues distinguishable.
strings.Приёмная учредителя МФЦ: Reception office of the MFC's founder
strings.Проверить фактические действия при удовл: Verify actual action when the complaint is upheld
strings.Проверьте исходное событие и единицы счё: Check the triggering event and counting units. The reply deadline may differ from the deadline for a specific action.
strings.Работник или центр как организация?: The employee or the centre as an organisation?
strings.Раздельно проверить отмену порядка и вос: Separately verify cancellation of the procedure and restoration of the applicant's violated position.
strings.Распоряжение и ответ организации позволя: The organisation's order and reply distinguish its decision from an employee's independent action.
strings.Рассчитайте последний день рассмотрения: Calculate the final day for reviewing the complaint. Do not confuse it with the separate deadline for sending a reasoned response after the decision. The case specifies no special shortening or separate procedure.
strings.Сопоставить распоряжение центра с порядк: Compare the centre's order with the document-forwarding procedure
strings.Сопоставьте новые сведения с предметом д: Compare the new information with the case's subject.
strings.Считать учредителем любого служащего рег: Treat any regional ministry employee as the founder.
strings.Установить, чьё решение оспаривается по: Establish whose decision is challenged by the documents: an employee's or the MFC's own decision.
strings.Учредитель автоматически предоставляет г: The founding authority automatically provides the public service instead of the specialist body.
strings.Центр окончательно рассматривает собстве: The centre finally reviews its own decision instead of the founder.
strings.Часть 1 статьи 11.2 допускает учредителя: Part 1 of Article 11.2 permits the founder or an official specially authorised by the constituent entity. The scenario excludes the second option.
strings.Чем подтверждено, что это решение МФЦ?: What confirms that this is the service centre's decision?
strings.учредитель многофункционального центра: the founder of the multifunctional centre
strings.учредителю многофункционального центра: to the founder of the multifunctional centre
